methodologyNotes: Roster covers 12 high-search smart plug models spanning entry-level Wi-Fi, Matter-over-Wi-Fi, and Matter-over-Thread tiers. Primary sources are manufacturer product/press pages (TP-Link/Kasa, Tapo, Wyze, Meross, SwitchBot, Eve, Emporia, Govee, GE Lighting/Cync, Amazon) supplemented by authoritative resellers (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, Home Depot) and specialist review sites (MatterAlpha, TechHive, PCWorld). Each product re-verified against at least one manufacturer or authoritative reseller page on 2026-06-19. priceUsd reflects the verified published US price for the config named in priceNote; where a clean published price for the named config could not be confirmed, the verified config is substituted and noted. Boolean specs use true/false; max_load_amps is the resistive/peak rating in amps; works_with lists verified voice/platform ecosystems as a comma-delimited string; pack_size is the retail configuration the priceUsd refers to. accessedAt 2026-06-19.

products.name: Kasa Smart Plug Mini EP25

specs.works_with: Alexa, Google Assistant, Apple HomeKit (Siri), Kasa app

products.provenance: TP-Link press release (20100) confirms June 1 2022 launch, 4-pack MSRP $49.99, HomeKit support, and real-time local energy monitoring. 15A/120V (~1800W) max from manufacturer spec. No hub required, 2.4GHz Wi-Fi only, indoor only. pack_size corrected to 4 to match the $49.99 EP25P4 config the price refers to.

products.name: Kasa Smart Plug Mini HS103
products.provenance: Kasa official page and Amazon HS103P4 listing confirm 15A/120VAC max, no hub, 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, Alexa/Google compatibility, indoor only, no energy monitoring (that belongs to KP115/KP125M). $29.99 is the 4-pack (HS103P4) MSRP; pack_size corrected to 4 to match the priced config. Exact original release date not reliably documented, left null.

products.name: Kasa Smart Wi-Fi Plug Slim KP125M

specs.works_with: Alexa, Google Assistant, Apple HomeKit (Siri), Samsung SmartThings

products.provenance: TP-Link press release (20552) confirms April 7 2023 launch as Kasa's first Matter-certified plug with energy monitoring, 2-pack MSRP $39.99, 4-pack $69.99, 15A/1800W, works with Apple Home/Alexa/Google/SmartThings. Indoor-only, 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, no hub for Matter. Corroboration URL updated to the official Amazon KP125M 2-pack listing.

products.name: Wyze Plug
products.priceNote: 2-pack street price from wyze.com; sold as WLPP1CFH-1
products.provenance: Wyze indoor Plug (WLPP1CFH), 15A, 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, no hub, indoor only, works with Alexa/Google/IFTTT; released early 2021. The indoor model offers only runtime scheduling, not real-time power/energy monitoring (that feature is on the Wyze Plug Outdoor), so energy_monitoring is false. ~$29.98 for the 2-pack. Corroboration switched to Home Depot WLPP1CFH 2-pack listing (model-exact).

products.name: Amazon Smart Plug
products.priceNote: MSRP single unit (original model B01MZEEFNX); also relisted as B089DR29T6
products.provenance: Amazon Smart Plug: Alexa-only, 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, no hub, indoor, no energy monitoring. Original model B01MZEEFNX launched late 2018 (the linked B089DR29T6 is the 'works with Alexa+' relisting of the same device). $24.99 single-unit MSRP confirmed via Best Buy. 15A is the standard US rating; international model is 10A.

products.name: Govee Smart Plug Pro H5086

specs.works_with: Alexa, Google Assistant, Govee Home app

products.provenance: Govee US store confirms model H5086, 15A/1800W, real-time energy monitoring (power/current/voltage with daily/weekly/monthly history), Wi-Fi+Bluetooth, Alexa/Google, no hub, indoor only, no HomeKit/Matter. Verified sale $32.99 for both 2- and 4-pack (regular $59.99); priceNote corrected (draft labeled $32.99 as 4-pack only). Release year not reliably documented, left null.

products.name: Meross Matter Smart Wi-Fi Plug Mini MSS115

specs.works_with: Alexa, Google Assistant, Apple HomeKit (Siri), Samsung SmartThings, Matter ecosystem

products.provenance: Meross official store and MatterAlpha confirm MSS115 (US/CA), 2-pack MSRP $34.99 (sale $29.99), Matter over Wi-Fi (2.4GHz), all major Matter platforms. Max 10A/1200W (rated lower than 15A peers). No energy monitoring (that is MSS315). No hub, indoor only. releaseDate set to 2024-04-09 per MatterAlpha (draft had null).

products.name: TP-Link Tapo Smart Plug Mini P125M

specs.works_with: Alexa, Google Assistant, Apple HomeKit (Siri), Samsung SmartThings, Tapo app

products.provenance: Official Tapo press release (news/305) confirms launch January 30 2023 (NOT March 10) and MSRP $19.99 (the draft's claim of a $49.99 launch MSRP that 'dropped' is fabricated; $19.99 was the launch MSRP). Matter over Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, no hub, 15A/1800W, works with Apple Home/Alexa/Google/SmartThings. No energy monitoring (that is P110M). Source switched to the manufacturer press release.

products.name: Emporia Energy Monitoring Smart Plug
products.priceNote: 4-pack sale price (reg $47.99) from shop.emporiaenergy.com; 1- and 2-pack also sold (1-pack price not separately published as of access date)
products.provenance: Emporia store confirms real-time energy monitoring, 15A peak (1hr/day) / 10A continuous, 1800W@120V, 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, ETL certified, Alexa/Google, no hub for standalone use. The verified $34.99 sale / $47.99 regular price is for the 4-PACK (the draft mislabeled it as the 1-pack); pack_size corrected 1->4. No clean separately-published 1-pack USD price found on the access date. Release year not documented, null.

products.name: GE Cync Indoor Smart Plug

specs.works_with: Alexa, Google Assistant, Apple HomeKit (Siri), Samsung SmartThings

products.provenance: GE Lighting (Cync) page and MatterAlpha review confirm ~$14.99, 15A/1/3HP max, Matter + Wi-Fi + Bluetooth, works with Alexa/Google/Apple Home/SmartThings, no hub, indoor only, no energy monitoring. Source URL updated to the active gelighting.com Matter-compatible product page (draft's shop.gelighting.com permalink was non-canonical). Release year ~2023.

products.name: Eve Energy (Matter)

specs.works_with: Alexa, Google Assistant, Apple HomeKit (Siri), Samsung SmartThings, Home Assistant

products.provenance: Eve official page and Amazon listing confirm $39.95 MSRP (US/Canada), Matter over Thread, energy monitoring (Eve app + Matter 1.3 firmware), 15A/1800W, works with Apple Home/Alexa/Google/SmartThings/Home Assistant. Hub required: Thread needs a Thread Border Router + Matter controller (e.g. HomePod mini, Echo 4th gen). Corroboration switched to the manufacturer-Amazon listing.

products.name: SwitchBot Plug Mini
products.priceNote: MSRP single unit (Wi-Fi model) from us.switch-bot.com; 4-pack also available. Separate HomeKit-enabled variant ~$14.99

specs.works_with: Alexa, Google Assistant, Siri Shortcuts, Samsung SmartThings, IFTTT, Home Assistant

products.provenance: SwitchBot US store confirms 15A resistive max (~1875W), 2.4GHz Wi-Fi + Bluetooth LE, real-time energy monitoring with historical export, no hub, indoor only. Compatible with Alexa, Google, Siri Shortcuts, SmartThings, IFTTT, Home Assistant. Single-unit MSRP $11.99; released 2022 (release_year filled in, draft had null). This entry covers the standard Wi-Fi model; a separate HomeKit-enabled variant exists at ~$14.99. Source/corroboration URLs normalized to live us.switch-bot.com and Walmart listings.
